judgments.label: true_positive
judgments.rationale: This img is BBC's lazy-load stand-in (src grey-placeholder.png, class hide-when-no-script). It sits under the real photo img:nth-of-type(2), which has the same bounds and alt "A photo of Maricarmen Abascal at Madrid's Puerta del Sol". The placeholder is pure decoration, but it is exposed as role=img with aria-label "image unavailable", so a screen reader announces a false 'image unavailable' before the real photo. 1.1.1 requires decoration to be ignorable by assistive technology (F39: non-null alt on an image that should be ignored), so this element does fail. The finding's diagnosis is wrong, though. Its crop showed the overlapping real photo. The patch, which gives the placeholder a description of that photo, would only duplicate the sibling's alt. The fix is alt="" or aria-hidden="true" on the placeholder.
